item.title: Baltimore Rec & Parks offers School's Out Day of Play on March 6 for $30
item.description: Baltimore City Rec & Parks hosts School's Out Day of Play on March 6 from 8 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. for kids ages 5-12 at four locations for $30.

item.title: ‘Why did this happen?’: Veterans’ mental health care disrupted after clinic removed from VA Network
item.description: VA technical error removes Bel Air veteran mental health clinic from network, canceling appointments for 10-15 veterans weekly before reinstatement after media inquiry.

item.title: McDaniel College men's basketball heads to playoffs for first time in a decade
item.description: McDaniel College men's basketball clinches first Centennial Conference Tournament berth since 2016 with a 52-49 win over Muhlenberg, finishing 16-9 on the season.
